issues.detail: The Hebrew ends with 'אֲבִי ברזות' (father of Birzavith/Berzoth), but the Vietnamese renders 'cha của Bích-xa-vít' — 'Bích-xa-vít' does not match the Hebrew name 'ברזות' (Birzavith/Berzoth). The Vietnamese name appears to be a different name, possibly a transliteration error or substitution.
